in_marathi.name: Yashpal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yashpal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Yashpal is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Yas’ (God) and ‘Pal’ (treasure). This name is a tribute to the belief that the true wealth lies in the blessings of the divine. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is often referred to as the protector and preserver of all treasures.

vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word याश् (Yash), which means 'light' or 'radiance'. The suffix पल (pal) means 'to grow' or 'to flourish', hence the name Yashpal means 'one who grows in light' or 'one who flourishes in radiance'.
